attributes.action: National Commission to Maximise Benefits of Devolution
attributes.additional_details: Defusing growing political discord is becoming urgent. Devolution offers that with a once-in-a-lifetime chance to reshape Democracy & fix "Broken Britain.” Maximising the enormous potential it offers, however, cannot be a partisan effort. It demands comprehensive evaluation across the political spectrum. Realistically it needs to be considered in conjunction with electoral reform, hence my petition for a National Commission to do it justice. We owe it to ourselves and future generations.
attributes.background: Devolution is a once-in-a-lifetime chance to reshape Democracy & fix "Broken Britain." But, maximising its enormous potential demands proper & thorough evaluation & debate, rather than partisanship. Innately integral to electoral reform, it needs its own Commission or to be included in that one.
